title: auxiliary recovery driver applied execution preflight to SPEC_READINESS
symptom: The auxiliary continuation script marked SPEC_READINESS BLOCKED with OFFICIAL_PREFLIGHT_BLOCKED and recorded a NOT_RUN journal event even though official execution state was already COMPLETE.

evidence.observed: harness=NOT_RUN; preflightExecutionOperation was incorrectly attempted for a SPEC_* lifecycle operation; no model call occurred
evidence.finalizer: No raw result was produced because the auxiliary command path was invalid

rootCause: The temporary recovery driver omitted the official driver's guard that execution preflight applies only to non-SPEC operations. It treated SPEC_READINESS as an execution operation and persisted a driver-owned journal event for a call that never reached the harness.
responsibleBoundary: /tmp/sentinel-recover-a.mjs auxiliary continuation only; repository production driver was not changed
correction: Correct the auxiliary driver to skip execution preflight for every SPEC_* operation, preserve this workspace as diagnostic evidence, and do not use its journal as final convergence evidence.
whyCodeVsPrompt: This is a test-driver condition, not a workflow authority or model semantic issue. The repository production pilot already contains the correct SPEC_* guard; no repository source or validator was changed.

regression.test: Existing benchmark production-pilot coverage for lifecycle operations and preflight routing
regression.result: repository production driver unchanged; auxiliary script correction pending before any continuation

localValidation: No repository source edit; C87 local suite remained PASS
liveReplay: auxiliary continuation must be restarted from a clean fresh workspace for final evidence
result: diagnostic only; excluded from final convergence
